title: FBI Photo B3
what_is_it: A monochrome still image captured from a U.S. military sensor system showing an unidentified circular object, submitted by the FBI to AARO.
interpretation_warnings: The extracted text from the PDF is largely garbled and unreadable, likely due to heavy redaction overlays and OCR artifacts on a low-quality sensor image.
Heavy redaction was applied before submission — the original, unredacted image has not been made public.
No accompanying mission report was provided, making this a single-source observation with no corroborating data.
The on-screen timestamp is confirmed incorrect (shows 1999 instead of 2025), so no time-based analysis should rely on it.
Most factual content comes from the CSV metadata description rather than readable text within the document itself.
The narrative description from the source explicitly warns readers not to interpret it as an analytical judgment or investigative conclusion.

verifiable_claims.claim: The displayed date of 12/31/99 is incorrect due to the system clock not being set.
